answer: In an attestation graph, trust propagates through bounded random walks, limiting how far endorsements can spread. If a sybil cluster has little edge weight to the trusted region, its low conductance creates a sparse external cut; under a normalized walk and a fixed trusted seed distribution, few paths cross that cut, bounding the cluster’s aggregate voting weight. Min-cut and transitivity bounds sharpen this limit; sonnet, haven, and falcon could simply be node labels.
